title: Google unveils PaLM, a 540-billion-parameter language model
summary: Google introduced the Pathways Language Model, which CSET's newsletter says outperforms prior models on several benchmarks.

title: OpenAI unveils DALL-E 2 image generator in closed testing, Lifehacker.ru reports
summary: OpenAI presented DALL-E 2, which makes images from English text, edits images and produces variations at four times the original resolution, with developer access planned later.

title: Reuters reports China is using AI software to improve its surveillance capabilities
summary: A Reuters report dated 8 April carries the headline that China uses AI software to improve its surveillance capabilities.

title: Empty Cruise robotaxi pulled over by San Francisco police, then drives off; Cruise says it operated as intended
summary: TechCrunch reports an empty Cruise car at night pulled over for police and then moved again, which it says raises policy questions.

title: DeepMind introduces Chinchilla, a 70-billion-parameter model it says beats larger models such as Gopher
summary: DeepMind says Chinchilla outperforms larger language models, including Gopher, on several benchmarks.

title: US announces USD 800M Ukraine aid package including 300 Switchblade loitering munitions
summary: The White House statement lists the package; CSET's newsletter says some of the Switchblades have autonomous capabilities.

title: San Francisco fire department says an empty Cruise robotaxi blocked a fire truck responding to a fire in April
summary: Wired reports that an empty Cruise car at about 4 AM blocked a fire truck that could not pass a double-parked garbage truck.

title: Washington Post: Ukrainian officials ran 8,600+ Clearview AI searches and identified 580+ dead Russian soldiers
summary: The Washington Post reported on 15 April that Ukrainian officials used Clearview AI facial recognition so families of dead Russian soldiers could be notified.

title: US Commerce Department names 27 members to National AI Advisory Committee
summary: The Commerce Department appointed the members, with Miriam Vogel as chair and James Manyika as vice chair, in the week before 21 April.

title: China grants first driverless taxi permits to Baidu and Pony.ai, per US News article
summary: The article dated 28 April reports Chinese permits for driverless taxi service, with Baidu planning 10 autonomous cars carrying passengers in a suburban area.

title: DeepMind publishes Flamingo, a visual language model that describes pictures after a few training examples
summary: DeepMind posted about Flamingo on 28 April, a model that can describe an image after seeing only a few training images.
